built_not_yet_live.name: German LP v2 - brand-matched, trust-led
built_not_yet_live.note: v2 PUBLISHED 2026-07-30 after Lucas's design feedback on v1. Now uses the real LP design system (navy/gold/cream, Cinzel and Raleway) instead of an approximation, fixes product images that were being cropped out of proportion, drops the 'Recommended for Germany' badge, and rewrites the German with proper umlauts (v1 used ASCII workarounds like 'gross' and 'Laender', which reads cheap to a German reader and was probably much of why it looked wrong). Trust content is built around what a German buyer actually checks before ordering from abroad: ships from the EU with no customs, 4 to 8 working days with tracking, 14-day statutory right of withdrawal, prices marked inkl. MwSt., and Impressum plus Widerrufsbelehrung in the footer. CORRECTION MADE DURING THE BUILD: the first draft listed giropay and Sofortueberweisung as payment methods. Neither is offered. I verified the real set against the live storefront (PayPal, Klarna, SEPA, Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay) and removed the invented ones. TWO CLAIMS STILL NEED LUCAS TO CONFIRM BEFORE THIS COULD GO LIVE: whether pay-by-invoice is actually enabled in Klarna (the single strongest German trust lever, currently left off the page because it is unverified), and whether 'ships from the EU, 4 to 8 working days' is accurate. UNDERLYING THESIS STILL UNVERIFIED: the page leads with the Base Game on the assumption Germany wants a lower-risk entry, and the country-by-product split needed to test that is still blocked on Shopify access.
